scenes.caption: The date.
scenes.say: Friday 14 June. Dear Diary, we camped in the Margalla Hills.

scenes.caption: After lunch.
scenes.say: After lunch, we hiked up a winding trail.

scenes.caption: Progressive.
scenes.say: We were walking quietly when a monkey leapt past.

scenes.caption: Informal.
scenes.say: It was totally amazing. We didn't expect that!

scenes.caption: Later.
scenes.say: Later that evening, we pitched our tent under the pines.

scenes.caption: The torch.
scenes.say: Suddenly, the torch flickered and the wood fell silent.

scenes.caption: Feelings now.
scenes.say: Now I am tucked in my sleeping bag. I feel happy and a little nervous.
